definitions.explanation: A harbor or port area, especially when referring to the infrastructure and facilities as a whole. More formal and technical than 港 alone.

examples.japanese: {港湾|こうわん}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Development of port facilities is progressing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{港湾|こうわん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発展|はってん}して→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧きた。
examples.english: This area has developed with the port at its center.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{港湾|こうわん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{船舶|せんぱく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}れる→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{水深|すいしん}→水深：18675_suishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: To function as an international port, sufficient water depth for large vessels is required.

notes:
USAGE: {港湾|こうわん} is a formal, technical term for a port or harbor, often used in administrative, logistics, and engineering contexts. In everyday speech, ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧ is more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {港湾|こうわん}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧ (port facilities)
- {港湾|こうわん}⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧ (port city)
- {港湾|こうわん}⟦{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}→労働者：23971_roudousha⟧ (port workers, longshoremen)
- {港湾|こうわん}⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧ (port development/maintenance)
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{港湾|こうわん} (international port)

SIMILAR WORDS: ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧ is the everyday word for a port or harbor. {港湾|こうわん} is the official/technical term that encompasses the entire port infrastructure. In compound modifiers (e.g., {港湾|こうわん}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧), {港湾|こうわん} is preferred over ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧.
